# Releem

> > Releem is an automated MySQL and MariaDB performance tuning platform that provides configuration optimization, health checks, and monitoring for database administrators.

Releem offers both cloud-based and agent-based solutions for MySQL/MariaDB performance optimization, including the Releem Agent for metric collection, TuningWizard for configuration recommendations, and comprehensive database health monitoring. The platform supports various environments including AWS RDS, self-hosted servers, and multiple operating systems.

## Key Topics

- MySQL performance tuning
- MariaDB optimization
- InnoDB configuration
- Releem Agent
- Database monitoring
- Configuration automation
- Query optimization
- Database health checks
- MySQLTuner alternative
- Performance metrics
- Deadlock detection
- Schema validation
- Full-text indexing
- TuningWizard
- DBA tools

## Performance Optimization Guides

- [Optimize and Improve MySQL Performance - Tuning Guide](https://releem.com/blog/mysql-performance-tuning): Comprehensive 8-step MySQL performance tuning and optimization guide
- [MySQL Deadlock Detection - check deadlocks on database](https://releem.com/blog/mysql-deadlock-detection): Detect and resolve MySQL/InnoDB deadlocks with automated monitoring
- [Comprehensive Guide to MySQL Full-Text Indexing: Examples, Creation, and Performance Optimization](https://releem.com/blog/comprehensive-guide-mysql-full-text-indexing): Guide to MySQL full-text indexing for efficient text search vs LIKE queries
- [MySQL Database Schema Checks: Best Practices and Solutions](https://releem.com/blog/mysql-database-schema-checks): Best practices for MySQL schema validation and optimization checks

## Database Monitoring and Health Checks

- [Keeping an Eye on MySQL with Health Checks](https://releem.com/blog/mysql-health-checks): MySQL health check monitoring strategies for database administrators

- [Complete Guide to MariaDB Logs: Audit, Configuration, and More](https://releem.com/blog/mariadb-logs): Comprehensive guide to MariaDB log types, configuration, and optimization
